title: ReceiptLingua Error Response
description: Envelope returned by the sidecar when a request fails.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this protocol schema, e.g. "0.1.0".

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Clients should switch on this, not on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. May change between versions; not for programmatic matching.

details.description: Optional structured context specific to the error code (e.g. the offending config key, the missing model name). Shape varies by code and is not further constrained here.
